dataset: PhysioNet Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019 v1.0.0
training_population: Adult ICU stays from training sets A and B; patient-grouped random development split
outcome: First Challenge SepsisLabel=1 at an hourly landmark; excludes subsequent positive follow-up rows
sampling: One landmark every 6 hours plus first positive landmark; features use current and trailing 6 hourly records only
threshold_selection: Validation threshold targeting at least 0.80 sensitivity; exploratory and not clinical
limitations: ICU population; not validated for ward deterioration or NEWS2
Retrospective challenge labels and non-random missingness
Random patient holdout is not temporal or external validation
Repeated landmark metrics are row-weighted; confidence intervals not computed
Research only; do not use for clinical decisions
